name: Inbound lead routing
short: Organize incoming inquiries and route them using your approved territory and ownership rules.
audience: Sales and revenue operations teams with an approved process and a named commercial owner.
problem: New inquiries arrive in shared inboxes, forms, and CRM queues. Missing ownership or inconsistent records can delay the first authorized response.
tasks: Check incoming records for required fields
Record the original source and received time
Apply written territory and ownership rules
Check the approved duplicate and suppression process
Route ambiguous records to revenue operations
workflow: Check source records and required fields
Route ambiguities before taking further action
boundaries: The assistant does not decide qualification, prices, discounts, contracts, or commercial promises.
Your sales team owns channel consent, targeting, and final approval.

scenarios.title: A common handoff
scenarios.body: An inquiry names two office locations. The assistant preserves both, records the uncertainty, and asks the territory owner to assign it instead of guessing.

scenarios.title: Starting with a controlled queue
scenarios.body: Choose one inbox or proposal type, agree a review checklist, and inspect the first week of records before expanding the role.

faq.q: Can the assistant make sales decisions?
faq.a: No. The assistant prepares records and follows approved routing. Qualification, negotiation, pricing, and commitments stay with authorized sellers.
The original request is preserved and sent to a named owner. Ambiguous records remain pending rather than being silently completed.

faq.q: What should we provide before starting?
faq.a: Provide current templates, required fields, source systems, access limits, and a reviewer who can resolve exceptions.

name: Sales proposal administration
short: Prepare approved proposal materials and keep versions, review requests, and next steps organized.
audience: Sales and revenue operations teams with an approved process and a named commercial owner.
problem: Proposal files, approved pricing sheets, and customer requests can diverge across inboxes. Sellers need one current package and a clear review owner.
tasks: Collect the seller-approved scope and source materials
Assemble the current template and attachments
Check names, dates, versions, and required sections
Route commercial content to the authorized reviewer
Log the approved dispatch and follow-up owner
workflow: Check source records and required fields
Route ambiguities before taking further action
boundaries: The assistant does not decide qualification, prices, discounts, contracts, or commercial promises.
